    \]

    \[
    \text{Percentage Change} = \left(\frac{\text{Change}}{\text{Operating Margin FY2021}}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{-10.6\%}{17.0\%}\right) \times 100 = -62.35\%

    \[
    \text{Change} = \text{Operating Margin FY2021} - \text{Operating Margin FY2020} = 17.0\% - 9.0\% = 8.0\%
    \]

    \[
    \text{Percentage Change} = \left(\frac{\text{Change}}{\text{Operating Margin FY2020}}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{8.0\%}{9.0\%}\right) \times 100 = 88.89\%
    \]

- **Operating Margin Calculation**:
  - Operating Margin Formula:
    \[
    \text{Operating Margin} = \left(\frac{\text{Operating Income}}{\text{Total Revenue}}\right) \times 100
    \]

    \[
    \text{Operating Margin FY2022} = \left(\frac{1,825}{13,031}\right) \times 100 = 6.4\%
    \]

    \[
    \text{Operating Margin FY2020} = \left(\frac{974}{12,160}\right) \times 100 = 9.0\%
    \]
